# Surface brief: Fileshaper website (docs/, generated by site/build.mjs)

Scope: standalone Fileshaper product site, multi-page and multi-language (EN, ES, FR, DE, RU, ZH). Visitor mode: Persuade (home, features, download); Read (changelog, privacy, FAQ, about).
Audience: everyday people who googled a file chore, plus admissions readers judging the maker.
Constraints: user-pinned craft bar Raycast / Linear / Apple marketing; rejected themed worlds; dark by default; a Hollowbit company site comes later and will link here.

## Direction contract
FORM: user-pinned canon (seed:ab6da4a403db85e6 hands declined); craft bar = raycast.com, linear.app, apple.com product pages.
THESIS: A software company's product site: real product at full scale, precise type, claims next to measured proof. It refuses glow edges, gradient text, eyebrow kickers, icon-tile card grids and stock illustration.
OWN-WORLD: Near-black ground with one warm-neutral panel layer, hairline rules, the anvil's orange only on primary actions and live state. Self-hosted Geist (sans and mono, for figures), tight display tracking and a fixed scale. App screenshots framed in a real window chrome with a crisp border and soft offset shadow.
STORY: Hero claim, then the product doing the job (command demo), then the four toolboxes in tabs with real screens, measured results, privacy as plain facts, download.
FIRST VIEWPORT: Headline "Fix any file. Nothing leaves your computer.", OS-aware download button, and a live command-bar demo that types an outcome and lands a measured result row, above a large app screenshot.
SIGNATURE: The live command demo: the site types "compress for discord" into a working replica of the app's command field and shows the 149 MB to 9.1 MB result, the way Raycast demos its launcher.
